starter_entities.label: RV
starter_entities.note: abnormal administrative recovery only; no normal demolition refund or regular cargo teleport

reference_six_player_entities.label: F2
reference_six_player_entities.recipe_schedule_note: Sequential recipe change is required. These outputs are not produced simultaneously.

notes: Only starter_entities and rocket_envelope are solid in the initial world.
reference_six_player_entities are a late-game placement example and MUST NOT be spawned at new-game start.
Source decorations are non-solid; only installed extractor footprints collide.
Source unlocks change interaction permission, not walkability.
The 32 factory slots demonstrate one accessible layout, not the maximum possible free placement count.
The 24-tile limit applies to delivery endpoint pairs; the hub has no 24-tile coverage radius.
A logistics hub activates the whole delivery network according to balance_v1.json.
The 32 reference delivery links are an economic costing assumption, not a complete route-topology proof.
A processing machine is not a generic relay. It only accepts inputs for its selected recipe and produces that recipe's outputs.
Normal demolition refunds go into a local non-solid recovery box at the demolition site. The fixed recovery_vault is for abnormal administrative recovery only.

rocket_envelope.label: ROCKET
rocket_envelope.note: Fixed construction envelope is visible as a marked work zone from the start; later models do not grow its ground collision.
